strategies.name: break_and_retest_continuation

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: step number one is you want to identify your key level
entry_sequence.action: Identify an obvious key level such as pre-market high/low, previous day high/low, 30-minute opening range high/low, or strong support/resistance.
entry_sequence.rationale: The setup starts from a clearly defined level the market is reacting to.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: wait for price to break the key level
entry_sequence.action: Wait for price to break above the key level for a long or break below the key level for a short with strong momentum and volume.
entry_sequence.rationale: The breakout should show commitment, not a weak drift through the level.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: Literally like a couple big candles through the level
entry_sequence.action: Require a clean, quick, aggressive push through the level rather than chopping through it.
entry_sequence.rationale: Strong expansion through the level helps validate the breakout.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: we want to wait for the retest
entry_sequence.action: After the break, wait for price to pull back and retest the broken level.
entry_sequence.rationale: The trader avoids chasing the initial breakout and waits for price to prove the level.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: We want to see price hold the level
entry_sequence.action: For a long, the broken resistance must hold as support; for a short, the broken support must hold as resistance.
entry_sequence.rationale: The retest confirms the old level has flipped into the new role.

entry_sequence.action: Enter only after confirmation on the retest: bullish price action for longs or bearish price action for shorts.
entry_sequence.rationale: Confirmation reduces false breakouts and keeps entries aligned with the hold.

stop.transcript_quote: Your stop is if price breaks back on the opposite side of the breakout level.
stop.rationale: The stop goes on the opposite side of the breakout level, invalidating the hold.

strategies.stop_management: In examples, he mentions trimming and stopping the rest at break even after partial profits.

targets.transcript_quote: your target is going to be the next obvious area of liquidity
targets.rationale: He targets the next obvious area where liquidity is sitting within the market.

targets.transcript_quote: could be the previous high or the previous low
targets.rationale: Previous highs or lows are cited as example liquidity targets.

targets.transcript_quote: Maybe you have a supply zone, demand zone, whatever
targets.rationale: He also allows supply or demand zones as target locations.

confluences.transcript_quote: we mainly want to focus on the most obvious ones
confluences.name: obvious_key_level
confluences.description: He wants the setup taken only at the most obvious levels in the market.

confluences.transcript_quote: we want strong momentum either at the breakout above resistance or the break below the support level
confluences.name: strong_breakout_momentum
confluences.description: He requires strong momentum on the breakout above resistance or below support.

confluences.transcript_quote: we do want to see volume confirmation
confluences.name: volume_confirmation
confluences.description: He explicitly wants volume confirmation on the breakout and retest behavior.

confluences.transcript_quote: It has to be very quick and aggressive through it
confluences.name: quick_aggressive_push
confluences.description: He wants the move through the level to be quick and aggressive, not weak or choppy.

confluences.transcript_quote: if it looks weak, we ignore the setup, and we do not take it
confluences.name: reject_weak_breaks
confluences.description: He skips any breakout-retest setup that looks weak.

confluences.transcript_quote: We want to see price hold the level
confluences.name: level_holds_on_retest
confluences.description: He needs price to hold the retested level before taking the trade.

confluences.transcript_quote: we are then going to look for either bullish price action, if we're looking for price to go up, or bearish price action, if we're looking for price to
confluences.name: bullish_or_bearish_retest_confirmation
confluences.description: He waits for bullish price action for longs or bearish price action for shorts on the retest.

confluences.transcript_quote: Long lower wicks, bullish hammers, dragonfly dojis
confluences.name: bullish_candle_confirmation
confluences.description: For longs, he wants long lower wicks, bullish hammers, or dragonfly dojis as confirmation.

confluences.transcript_quote: Long upper wicks, uh bearish hammers, gravestone dojis
confluences.name: bearish_candle_confirmation
confluences.description: For shorts, he wants long upper wicks, bearish hammers, or gravestone dojis as confirmation.

confluences.name: bookmap_liquidity_presence
confluences.description: He says Bookmap liquidity can be used to visually confirm buyers or sellers at the area.

confluences.transcript_quote: the first retest is always the highest probability
confluences.name: first_retest_only
confluences.description: He says the first retest is the highest-probability version of the setup.

confluences.name: a_plus_setups_only
confluences.description: He only wants the cleanest A+ versions of the setup.
